card.name: Partway through brand names and long words
card.fires_on: Fires on a piece in the middle of a drug brand name or long medical word in label text, such as KISUNLA, ZURZUVAE or Drug Interactions. It also fires on a few small words like 'the' before dose terms.

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: A piece in the middle of an unusual capitalized brand name.

modes.label: Inside long words
modes.description: A piece partway through a long clinical word or cross-reference phrase.

modes.label: Small word before dose term
modes.description: The word 'the' after a renal impairment clause, before maximum dose wording.
